name: Sharp Daisy-Completion Bound for Ordering Width
statement: For every finite nonempty $C$, $\delta_D(C)\geq 2^{\lfloor(\sigma(C)+1)/2\rfloor}+2^{\lceil(\sigma(C)+1)/2\rceil}-3$, and equality is attained at every nonnegative ordering width.
proof: At a maximum-cost predecessor disagreement, the two cube intervals from the intersection of the two supports contain only their endpoints from $C$. Counting their missing vertices and balancing their dimensions gives the bound. The antipodal pair family attains equality.
